verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a search engine that stores user data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack does not document any deletion APIs, retention policies, TTLs or data-purge controls. Self-hosting and SOC 2 mentions are adjacent deployment and compliance facts, not a documented retention or deletion capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
